_comment: P3G.2 (#22) PR-blocking gate baseline. pass_rate is (passed / (passed + failed)) among NON-xfail cases for the category, from a clean `pytest evals/ -m "not integration"` run -- see evals/conftest.py's pytest_sessionfinish hook and evals/runner/gate.py. Regenerate by running the suite and updating a category's pass_rate deliberately (in its own commit, with a reason) whenever an intentional, reviewed change lowers it -- never to silence an unexplained regression.

citation_present._note: #58: re-recorded 11 of 12 cases against the live qwen3-8b-q5 answer model (the 12th, statin-ck-myopathy-question, could not be re-recorded -- see its case file's comment -- and is unchanged from the qwen3:4b era). #81 (owner-decided methodology): flipped the semantic-support gate ON and re-judged (not re-drawn) the 6 stable, provenance-passing cases' committed answers with a LIVE support-judge call appended to each recording -- isolating the gate's effect from unrelated planner run-to-run variance (see docs/MODEL_AND_HARDWARE_SELECTION.md's variance caveat). 5 of those 6 are judged genuinely SUPPORTED and stay non-xfail; the 6th (statin-liver-monitoring-question, the case #47/#81 specifically targeted) is honestly downgraded to xfail -- a real, verbatim guideline quote paired with a claim asserting the opposite of what it says, which the judge correctly calls not_supported on both affected claims. The other 6 cases remain documented xfail (chart-data-only / extraction-decode patterns, unrelated to the gate). pass_rate is 1.0 because CategoryStats.pass_rate excludes xfailed cases from its denominator (5 passed / (5 passed + 0 failed) among the non-xfail cases) -- this baseline guards those 5 real, gate-ON-verified passes from regressing; it does NOT mean 12/12 pass. Honest gate-ON total: 5/12.
